passages.title: Acilis anlatimi + dunya tanitimi
passages.text: THE WORLD'S MOST POPULAR VRMMO, ZERO FANTASY ONLINE, COMMONLY KNOWN AS ZFO, HAD JUST RELEASED ITS LARGEST EXPANSION. IN THIS GAME, I WAS ON THE VERGE OF BECOMING THE FIRST PLAYER TO EVER HIT THE LEVEL CAP. MAYBE I OVERDID IT. TWO HUNDRED HOURS STRAIGHT IS A BIT MUCH, AND MY VISION WAS STARTING TO BLUR. ONCE I FINISH THIS QUEST, I'M GETTING A REAL MEAL AND CRASHING FOR A WHOLE DAY. HONESTLY, I NEVER CARED ABOUT RANKINGS BACK IN SCHOOL OR SPORTS. NO MATTER HOW HARD I TRIED, THAT NUMBER-ONE SPOT ALWAYS SLIPPED THROUGH MY FINGERS. BUT HERE, IN THE WORLD OF ZFO, THINGS ARE DIFFERENT. HERE, A NOBODY LIKE ME CAN FINALLY BECOME THE BEST IN THE WORLD. ALLEN, MY OLDEST FRIEND IN THE GUILD, KEPT TELLING ME TO SLOW DOWN. BUT ALLEN... HE HAS NO IDEA YET WHAT I'M ABOUT TO ATTEMPT. THIS TIME, I'M DOING IT ALONE. THE SYSTEM WINDOW FLICKERED BEFORE MY EYES. Lv.998. ONE MORE LEVEL. JUST HOLD ON A LITTLE LONGER. THE GUILD HALL WAS QUIET THAT NIGHT, AND THE TORCHES ON THE STONE WALLS CAST LONG SHADOWS ACROSS THE EMPTY TABLES. OUR GUILD WAS SMALL COMPARED TO THE GREAT HOUSES OF THE CAPITAL, BUT EVERY MEMBER HAD EARNED THEIR PLACE. THEY SAID A CRAFTER COULD NEVER STAND ON THE FRONT LINE, THAT OUR HANDS WERE MEANT FOR THE FORGE AND NOT FOR THE SWORD. IN THE GAME, EVERYONE TREATED THE CRAFTER PATH LIKE A TOTAL TRASH-TIER JOB, A JOKE FOR PLAYERS WHO COULDN'T FIGHT. WHICH MEANS THE QUEST I WAS ABOUT TO TAKE WOULD EITHER PROVE THEM ALL WRONG OR BURY MY NAME FOREVER. ADVENTURERS EARN A LIVING BY TRADING MONSTER PARTS AT THE ADVENTURER'S GUILD, BUT I HAD CHOSEN A DIFFERENT ROAD YEARS AGO. WHOKNEW ALL THOSE YEARS STUDYING FORGE PATTERNS INSTEAD OF SWORDPLAY WOULD PAY OFF HERE, ON THE EDGE OF THE IMPOSSIBLE. I WANTED TO LEAVE MY MARK ON HISTORY, NOT AS A MASTER OF THE FORGE, BUT AS THE PLAYER WHO BROKE THE CEILING NO ONE ELSE COULD EVEN TOUCH.

passages.title: Diyalog sahnesi
passages.text: "WHAT?! YOU'RE CHALLENGING THE DEMON KING'S ARMY BY YOURSELF?" ALLEN SHOUTED, GRABBING MY COLLAR. "ARE YOU OUT OF YOUR MIND?" "GAH... LET GO OF ME!" I PROTESTED. "DAMMIT, ALLEN, THIS IS MY FIGHT." "NO... NOT NOW...! NOT WHEN THE GUILD NEEDS ITS MASTER CRAFTER!" HE SNAPPED BACK. "DO YOU EVEN HEAR YOURSELF? A CRAFTER MARCHING INTO A BOSS RAID?" "HEY, BRAT," A ROUGH VOICE CUT IN. IT WAS ROEN, THE GUILD MASTER, LEANING AGAINST THE DOORWAY WITH HIS ARMS CROSSED. "DON'T LOOK DOWN ON CRAFTERS. EVERY SWORD IN THIS ROOM WAS FORGED BY ONE." ALLEN FELL SILENT. "BUT, MASTER ROEN... HIS LEVEL IS STILL TOO LOW FOR THAT QUEST." "THEN WE'LL FIX THAT," ROEN SAID WITH A GRIN. "LISTEN UP, KID. YOU'VE GOT COLD FEET BECAUSE YOU FAILED ONCE. EVERYONE IN THIS GUILD HAS A SCAR LIKE THAT. YOU ASKED FOR MY BLESSING, AND YOU'VE GOT IT. BUT ON ONE CONDITION. TAKE THIS." HE TOSSED ME A SMALL IRON KEY. "WHAT'S THIS?" "THE DOOR TO THE OLD TRAINING HALL. WHAT IF WE ACCIDENTALLY SEALED SOMETHING DANGEROUS DOWN THERE YEARS AGO...? WELL. YOU'LL FIND OUT." "YOU'VE GOT TO BE KIDDING ME." "I'M DEAD SERIOUS. THIS ENDS NOW, ONE WAY OR ANOTHER." ALLEN STARED AT THE KEY, THEN AT ME, AND SOMETHING IN HIS FACE SOFTENED. "FINE. BUT I'M COMING WITH YOU, AND THAT'S NOT UP FOR DEBATE." "YOU'LL SLOW ME DOWN." "AND YOU'LL GET YOURSELF KILLED WITHOUT ME. GUESS WE'RE STUCK WITH EACH OTHER." ROEN CHUCKLED. "THAT'S THE SPIRIT. REMEMBER, KIDS, THE TRAINING HALL DOESN'T FORGIVE MISTAKES. IF THINGS GO SOUTH, YOU RUN. NO HEROICS." "SINCE WHEN HAVE YOU KNOWN ME TO RUN?" I SAID. "SINCE THE GOBLIN AMBUSH LAST SPRING, WHEN YOU RAN SO FAST YOU LEFT YOUR BOOTS BEHIND," ALLEN SHOT BACK, AND EVEN ROEN BURST OUT LAUGHING. "HELP! MY BOOTS! SOMEBODY SAVE MY BOOTS!" ROEN MOCKED IN A HIGH VOICE, AND MY EARS BURNED. "SHUT UP! BOTH OF YOU!" "THEN STOP WASTING TIME AND MOVE!" ROEN ROARED. "THE SOUTH GATE CLOSES AT SUNDOWN, AND I AM NOT CARRYING EITHER OF YOU BACK!"

passages.title: Baskin + sistem pencereleri
passages.text: THE RAID BEGAN AT DAWN. [QUEST ACCEPTED: PURGE THE DEMON KING'S VANGUARD.] [PARTY MEMBERS: 4/4. RECOMMENDED LEVEL: 950.] "JUST HOLD ON!" ALLEN YELLED OVER THE ROAR OF THE FLAMES. "THEIR ATTACK PATTERN CHANGES WHEN THEIR HEALTH DROPS BELOW HALF!" I RAISED MY HAMMER. THE WEAPON FELT HEAVY, BUT MY HANDS HAD FINALLY STOPPED SHAKING. "EQUIPPED WITH AUTO-RELOAD. HOWEVER, ONCE THE MAGAZINE IS EMPTY, ATTACKING IS IMPOSSIBLE FOR SEVERAL SECONDS." THE OLD TUTORIAL LINE FLASHED THROUGH MY MIND, AND I ALMOST LAUGHED. "STOP!" ROEN BARKED. "DON'T WASTE YOUR SHOTS, KID. WAIT FOR MY SIGNAL!" THE GROUND TREMBLED. A MASSIVE SHADOW FELL ACROSS THE BATTLEFIELD. "WHAT THE...?!" "IT'S THE VANGUARD CAPTAIN!" SOMEONE SCREAMED. "FALL BACK! FALL BACK!" "NO!" I STEPPED FORWARD. "I'VE BEEN WAITING FOR THIS MOMENT!" MY HAMMER CAUGHT FIRE. [SPECIAL EFFECT: ADDS +5% ATTACK BONUS. ADDS EXPLOSIVE ATTRIBUTE.] [ATTACK 7 525. AMMO: 1. NOTES: NONE.] "YOU ASKED FOR IT, YOU UGLY BASTARD!" THE BLOW LANDED. [QUEST COMPLETE. EXP +500. LEVEL UP! Lv.999.] SILENCE. THEN THE GUILD CHANNEL ERUPTED. "DID HE JUST...?" "NO WAY. NO WAY!" ALLEN WAS LAUGHING AND CRYING AT THE SAME TIME. "YOU CRAZY, STUBBORN, MAGNIFICENT IDIOT!" "PLEASE! SOMEBODY TELL ME THAT REALLY HAPPENED!" ANOTHER VOICE CRIED. ROEN SHEATHED HIS BLADE SLOWLY, A RARE SMILE SPREADING ACROSS HIS SCARRED FACE. "I TAKE BACK EVERYTHING I EVER SAID ABOUT CRAFTERS," HE SAID QUIETLY. "TODAY, THE FORGE DEFEATED THE SWORD." THE SYSTEM WINDOWS KEPT SCROLLING. [TITLE EARNED: FIRST TO BREACH THE LEVEL CAP.] [GUILD FAME +1000. WORLD RANKING UPDATED.] ALLEN THREW AN ARM AROUND MY SHOULDERS. "DIE! DIE! DIE!" HE CHANTED LIKE AN IDIOT, POINTING AT THE FALLEN CAPTAIN. "STOP THAT, YOU LOOK RIDICULOUS." "NEVER! THIS IS THE BEST DAY OF MY LIFE!" ABOVE US, THE SKY OVER THE WORLD OF ZFO WAS FINALLY CLEAR. [LOOT ACQUIRED: CAPTAIN'S HORNED HELM. GRADE: LEGENDARY.] I LIFTED IT HIGH, AND THE SURVIVORS CHEERED UNTIL THEIR THROATS WERE RAW.
